what_was_done.action: Created src/lib/marker-routing.ts with interpretMarkerForRouting pure function
what_was_done.result: Exports interpretMarkerForRouting(marker, snapshot), RoutingDecision type, AgentType type (10-agent enum incl product-manager), EpicStateSnapshot type. Implements 5-tier precedence logic per architect memo § 6 Q4 + blocker-class mapping table per memo § 4 (7 known classes + coherence fallback).

All 12 tests pass. Covers all 5 precedence branches, all blocker-class mappings, precedence override cases (next_agent beats blocker_class, next_agent beats status), edge cases (missing status, whats_open without BLOCKER prefix).

what_was_tested: 12 unit tests in __tests__/lib/marker-routing.test.ts: (1) explicit next_agent=architect → override=true, nextAgent=architect; (2) blocked+design-question → architect; (3) blocked+test-fail → builder; (4) blocked+orchestrator-down → operator; (5) blocked+unknown-blocker-class → coherence fallback; (6) needs-decision+BLOCKER in whats_open → coherence; (7) success+no next_agent → override=false (pipeline-routes fallback); (8) failure → re-dispatch same-agent; (9) both next_agent and blocker_class → next_agent wins; (10) success+explicit next_agent=planner → override=true; (11) missing status → override=false with 'invalid marker'; (12) whats_open without BLOCKER prefix → fall through to status-based. Baseline regression: 3 suites / 11 tests pre-existing failures unchanged (92 total suites, 1919 total tests). npm run build: PASS.
deviations_from_ac: None. All 6 ACs verified. Minor: parameter renamed from snapshot to _snapshot to satisfy @typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars lint rule — parameter is in the signature per AC 1 for kvn/xfc callers but not referenced in current implementation.
